scenes.heading: Dependencies & Repository Structure
scenes.narration: Maven. Dependencies & Repository Structure. In this video we review 8 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What is the general dependency rule between ui.content and ui.apps?
scenes.heading: ui.content depends on ui.apps
scenes.body: Section 7 gives the general rule that packages with mutable content, ui.content, depend on the immutable code, ui.apps, that supports them.

scenes.question: In the simple case described by the speech, which package has no dependencies?
scenes.heading: ui.apps has no dependencies
scenes.body: The simple example in Section 7 says all has no dependencies, ui.apps has no dependencies, and ui.content depends on ui.apps.

scenes.question: What is the exception involving a code package that contains only OSGi bundles?
scenes.heading: No AEM package should declare a dependency on it
scenes.body: Section 7 says that if a code package contains only OSGi bundles, no AEM package should declare a dependency on it.
scenes.narration: What is the exception involving a code package that contains only OSGi bundles? No AEM package should declare a dependency on it. Section 7 says that if a code package contains only OSGi bundles, no AEM package should declare a dependency on it.

scenes.question: Why is depending on a package that contains only OSGi bundles a problem?
scenes.heading: Because it is not registered with Package Manager, so the dependency is unsatisfied and installation fails
scenes.body: The lesson explains that such a package is not registered with Package Manager, so any AEM package that depends on it has an unsatisfied dependency and fails to install.

scenes.question: In a complex deployment with several sites, what dependency chain does the speech give for site-specific packages?
scenes.heading: site-a.ui.apps depends on common.ui.apps, and site-a.ui.content depends on site-a.ui.apps
scenes.body: Section 7 gives a multi-site example where site-a.ui.apps depends on common.ui.apps, and site-a.ui.content depends on site-a.ui.apps.

scenes.question: What additional requirement applies to code packages with packageType application?
scenes.heading: They need a repository structure package
scenes.body: Section 7 says code packages, those with packageType application, also need a repository structure package.

scenes.question: Which FileVault plugin element configures the repository structure package?
scenes.heading: repositoryStructurePackage
scenes.body: The speech says the repository structure package is configured with the repositoryStructurePackage element in the FileVault package Maven plugin.

scenes.question: What does the repository structure package enforce, and which module does the archetype generate for it?
scenes.heading: It enforces structural dependency correctness so one code package does not install over another's folders, and the archetype generates ui.apps.structure
scenes.body: Section 7 says the repository structure package enforces correctness of structural dependencies so one code package does not install over another's folders, and that the archetype generates a ui.apps.structure module for this.
